question: Which of the following signals is a distress signal?
options: In radiotelephony the spoken words PAN, PAN.
The repeated switching on and off the landing lights.
A parachute flare showing a red light.
The repeated switching on and off of the navigation lights.
explanation: 📌 Hafıza Çivisi: Bu sorunun kilit cevabı -> A parachute flare showing a red light

question: Under which conditions may an aircraft on a straight-in-VOR approach continue it’s descend below the OCA?
options: When the aircraft is in visual contact with the ground and with the runway lights in sight
When the aircraft has the control tower in sight
When the aircraft is in contact with the ground but not with the runway in sight yet
explanation: 📌 Hafıza Çivisi: Unutma: When the aircraft is in visual contact with the ground and with the runway lights in sight

question: What will be the transponder mode and code for radio communication failure?
explanation: 📌 Hafıza Çivisi: Bu sorunun kilit cevabı -> Mode A code 7600

question: When an aircraft carries a serviceable transponder; the pilot shall operate the transponder:
options: Only when the aircraft is flying within controlled airspace.
Only when the aircraft is flying within airspace where SSR is used for ATS purposes.
At all times during flight, regardless of whether the aircraft is within or outside airspace where SSR is used for ATS purposes.
explanation: 📌 Hafıza Çivisi: Unutma: At all times during flight, regardless of whether the aircraft is within or outside airspace where SSR is used for ATS purposes

question: When the aircraft carries serviceable Mode C equipment, the pilot:
options: Shall continuously operate this mode only when directed by ATC.
Shall continuously operate this mode unless otherwise directed by ATC.
Shall continuously operate this mode regardless of ATC instructions.
Shall continuously operate this mode only when the aircraft is within controlled airspace.
explanation: 📌 Hafıza Çivisi: Unutma: Shall continuously operate this mode unless otherwise directed by ATC

question: The pilot of an aircaft losing two-way communications shall set the transponder to Mode A Code:
explanation: 📌 Hafıza Çivisi: Bu sorunun kilit cevabı -> 7600

question: When an aircraft is subjected to unlawful interference, the pilot-in-command shall indicate the situation by setting the transponder to:
explanation: 📌 Hafıza Çivisi: Bu sorunun kilit cevabı -> 7500

question: Pilots shall not operate the SSR special position indicator (IDENT) feature unless:
options: They operate a transponder with Mode C.
explanation: 📌 Hafıza Çivisi: Bu sorunun kilit cevabı -> Requested by ATC

question: When shall the SQUAWK IDENT button be pushed by the pilot?
options: After the setting of a different code has been requested by ATC.
For test purposes if the pilot is in doubt of the correct functioning of the transponder.
If the mode C equipment is unserviceable.
explanation: 📌 Hafıza Çivisi: Bu sorunun kilit cevabı -> Only if requested by ATC

question: ATIS broadcast messages containing departure and arrival information should include cloud cover, when the clouds are:
options: Below 2 000 m (600 ft) or below the highest minimum sector altitude, whichever is the greater
Below 900 m (3.000 ft) or below the highest minimum sector altitude, whichever is the greater
Below 1 500 m (5.000 ft) or below the highest minimum sector altitude, whichever is the greater
explanation: 📌 Hafıza Çivisi: Unutma: Below 1 500 m (5.000 ft) or below the highest minimum sector altitude, whichever is the greater

question: The ATIS broadcast message should, whenever practicable, not exceed;
explanation: 📌 Hafıza Çivisi: Bu sorunun kilit cevabı -> 30 seconds

question: Whenever ATIS is provided, the preparation and dissemination of the ATIS message shall be the responsability of;
options: the meteorological office serving the aerodrome (s)
both air traffic services and the meteorological office
the unit as prescribed the states
explanation: 📌 Hafıza Çivisi: Bu sorunun kilit cevabı -> the air traffic services

question: ATIS broadcast;
options: Shall not be transmitted on the voice of a VOR
Shall be transmitted on the voice channel of an ILS, on a discrete VHF frequency or on the voice channel of a VOR
Shall not be transmitted on the voice channel of an ILS
Shall only be transmitted on a discrete VHF frequency
explanation: 📌 Hafıza Çivisi: Unutma: Shall not be transmitted on the voice channel of an ILS

question: The Alerting Service is provided by:
options: The ATC unit responsible for the aircraft at that moment, when it is provided with 121.5 MHz.
The ATS unit responsible for the aircraft at that moment.
explanation: 📌 Hafıza Çivisi: Unutma: The ATS unit responsible for the aircraft at that moment

question: The phases related to an aircraft in emergency or believed in emergency are:
options: uncertainty phase, alert phase, distress phase and urgency phase.
uncertainty phase, urgency phase, distress phase.
uncertainty phase, distress phase, urgency phase.
uncertainty phase, alert phase, distress phase.
explanation: 📌 Hafıza Çivisi: Bu sorunun kilit cevabı -> uncertainty phase, alert phase, distress phase

question: When an aircraft is experiencing difficulties, triggering of the alert phase is the responsibility of:
options: air traffic control and flight information centers.
explanation: 📌 Hafıza Çivisi: Unutma: air traffic control and flight information centers

question: Which is the content of section 2 of Air-Report (AIREP)?
options: Present position, estimated time of arrival (ETA).
Estimated time over FIR boundary, endurance.
explanation: 📌 Hafıza Çivisi: Bu sorunun kilit cevabı -> Estimated time of arrival (ETA), endurance

question: Which letter is used in a flight plan to indicate that the flight commences in accordance with VFR and subsequently changes to IFR?
explanation: 📌 Hafıza Çivisi: Bu sorunun kilit cevabı -> Z

question: In the event of a delay for an uncontrolled flight, which a flight plan has been submitted, the flight plan should be amended or a new flight plan submitted and the old one cancelled, when:
options: The delay is more than 30 minutes of the estimated time off-blocks.
The delay is more than 60 minutes of the estimated time off-blocks.
The delay is more than 60 minutes of the estimated time of departure.
The delay is more than 30 minutes of the estimated time off departure.
explanation: 📌 Hafıza Çivisi: Unutma: The delay is more than 60 minutes of the estimated time off-blocks

question: A pilot receiving an IFR clearance from ATC should:
options: Read back those parts containing level assignments, vectors or any part requiring verification.
Read back the initial route clearance, level assignments and transponder codes.
Read back the entire clearance as required by regulation.
explanation: 📌 Hafıza Çivisi: Unutma: Read back the entire clearance as required by regulation

question: The planned cruising speed for the first leg or all of the cruising portion of the flight must be entered in the speed box of a flight plan form. This speed is the:
explanation: 📌 Hafıza Çivisi: Bu sorunun kilit cevabı -> true air speed (TAS)

question: If no ICAO identifier has been attributed to an alternate airport (box 16) of a flight plan form...
options: write XXXX in box 16 and indicate in box 18 (additional information) ALTN/followed by the name of the airport
write ZZZZ in box 16 and indicate in box 18 (additional information) ALTN/followed by the name of the airport.
write XXXX in box 16 and indicate in box 18 (additional information) DEGT/followed by the name of the airport
write ZZZZ in box 16 and indicate in box 18 (additional information) DEGT/followed by the name of the airport.
explanation: 📌 Hafıza Çivisi: Unutma: write ZZZZ in box 16 and indicate in box 18 (additional information) ALTN/followed by the name of the airport

question: Track separation between aircraft using the same NDB shall be applied requiring the aircraft to fly:
options: At least 45° separated at a distance of 15 NM or more from the facility.
At least 15° separated at a distance of 15 NM or more from the facility.
At least 30° separated at a distance of 15 NM or more from the facility.
At least 30° separated at a distance of 15 miles or more from the facility.
explanation: 📌 Hafıza Çivisi: Unutma: At least 30° separated at a distance of 15 NM or more from the facility

question: Track separation between aircraft using the same FIX shall be applied requiring the aircraft to fly:
options: At least 30° separated at a distance of 15 NM or more from the FIX.
At least 45° separated at a distance of 15 miles or more from the FIX.
At least 45° separated at a distance of 15 NM or more from the fix.
At least 30° separated at a distance of 15 miles or more from the FIX.
explanation: 📌 Hafıza Çivisi: Unutma: At least 45° separated at a distance of 15 NM or more from the fix

question: If an ATC clearance is not suitable to the pilot in command of an aircraft:
options: The pilot has to accept the ATC clearance because it has been based on the flight plan filed with ATC.
He may request another clearance and the ATC concerned has to accept the pilot request.
He may request and, if practicable, obtain an amended clearance.
The pilot should propose another clearance to the ATC concerned.
explanation: 📌 Hafıza Çivisi: Unutma: He may request and, if practicable, obtain an amended clearance

question: What are the controlled IFR separation methods applied by ATC?
explanation: 📌 Hafıza Çivisi: Bu sorunun kilit cevabı -> Vertical, horizontal and composite separation

question: Track separation between aircraft using the same VOR shall be applied requiring the aircraft to fly:
options: At least 15° separated at a distance of 15 miles or more from the facility.
At least 30° separated at a distance of 15 NM or more from the facility.
At least 45° separated at a distance of 15 NM or more from the facility.
At least 15° separated at a distance of 15 NM or more from the facility.
explanation: 📌 Hafıza Çivisi: Unutma: At least 15° separated at a distance of 15 NM or more from the facility

question: Lights on and in the vicinity of aerodromes may be turned off, provided that they can be again brought into operation :
options: At least 5 minutes before the expected arrival of an aircraft
At least 30 minutes before the expected arrival of an aircraft
At least 15 minutes before the expected arrival of an aircraft
At least one hour before the expected arrival of an aircraft
explanation: 📌 Hafıza Çivisi: Unutma: At least one hour before the expected arrival of an aircraft

question: The definition of "Manoeuvring Area" is:
options: That part of an aerodrome to be used for take-off, landing and taxiing of aircraft, including apron(s).
That part of an aerodrome to be used for take-off, landing and taxiing of aircraft, excluding apron(s).
That part of an aerodrome to be used for take-off, landing and taxiing of aircraft, including movement area and apron(s).
None of the above is correct.
explanation: 📌 Hafıza Çivisi: Unutma: That part of an aerodrome to be used for take-off, landing and taxiing of aircraft, excluding apron(s)

question: One of the functions ensured by a radar control unit for the provision of approach control service is:
options: To apply a reduced vertical separation of 500 feet between IFR flights and VFR flights.
To apply a horizontal separation less than 5 NM.
To provide instructions in order to reduce separations minima, if accepted by the pilots.
explanation: 📌 Hafıza Çivisi: Bu sorunun kilit cevabı -> To conduct surveillance radar approaches

question: The primary duty provided by a radar unit is:
options: To assist aircraft on the location storms.
To assist aircraft due to failure of airborne equipment.
To assist aircraft where navigation appears unsatisfactory.
explanation: 📌 Hafıza Çivisi: Bu sorunun kilit cevabı -> To provide radar separation

question: When radar identification of aircraft has been achieved, ATC unit shall:
options: Inform the aircraft only if communication's load permits it.
Inform the aircraft prior to issue any instructions or advice based on the use of radar.
not advise the aircraft before issuing instructions.
Inform the aircraft only if radar identification has been achieved without availability of SSR.
explanation: 📌 Hafıza Çivisi: Unutma: Inform the aircraft prior to issue any instructions or advice based on the use of radar

question: In which section of AIP are contained information elements relating to areas and/or routes for which meteorological service is provided?
explanation: 📌 Hafıza Çivisi: Bu sorunun kilit cevabı -> GEN

question: The SIGMET service, is in the AIP, in the following part :
explanation: 📌 Hafıza Çivisi: Bu sorunun kilit cevabı -> GEN

question: The informations concerning charges for aerodromes/heliports and Air Navigation Services are on the following part of the AIP;
explanation: 📌 Hafıza Çivisi: Bu sorunun kilit cevabı -> GEN

question: Select the acronym corresponding to the following definition: an special NOTAM series notifying, by means of a specific format, an important change for the aircraft operations, due to a volcano activity, a volcano eruption or a volcanic ash cloud.
explanation: 📌 Hafıza Çivisi: Bu sorunun kilit cevabı -> ASHTAM

question: What is an ASHTAM used for?
options: Aerodromes closed by volcanic ash contamination.
explanation: 📌 Hafıza Çivisi: Bu sorunun kilit cevabı -> Volcanic activity

question: Tehlikeli madde kazası olaylarında, tehlikeli maddelerin havayolu ile taşınması esnasında hangi şartlar oluştuğunda kaza raporu yazılır?
options: Bir kişinin yaralanması ya da ölmesi, havaaracının zarar görmesi, yangın, sıvının akması, radyasyon yayılımı durumunda
Tehlikeli madde paketine yanlış etiket yapıştırılması durumunda
Tehlikeli madde paketinin etiketinin yırtılması durumunda
explanation: 📌 Hafıza Çivisi: Unutma: Bir kişinin yaralanması ya da ölmesi, havaaracının zarar görmesi, yangın, sıvının akması, radyasyon yayılımı durumunda

question: Tehlikeli maddelerin uçakta taşınabilmesi için, hangi şartların yerine getirilmesi gereklidir?
options: Havayolu şirketine ait olan kargo taşımacılığı kurallarına uygun olmalıdır
ICAO/IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations taşımacılık kuralları ile uygun ambalajlama ve dokümantasyonu konusunda uyumlu olmalıdır
ICAO kuralları gereği tahditli maddeler uçaklarda taşınamaz
explanation: 📌 Hafıza Çivisi: Unutma: ICAO/IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations taşımacılık kuralları ile uygun ambalajlama ve dokümantasyonu konusunda uyumlu olmalıdır

question: Genel anlamda tahditli maddelerin el bagajı olarak veya el bagajında taşınmaları yasaktır. Fakat belirli kurallar çerçevesinde bir kısmının el bagajı olarak yolcu kabininde taşınmasına müsamaha gösterilebilir. Aşağıdakilerden hangileri bu istisnai durumlara örnektir?
explanation: 📌 Hafıza Çivisi: Bu sorunun kilit cevabı -> Gazlı saç kıvırma maşası

question: Tehlikeli maddelerin kusursuz bir şekilde yüklenmesinden kim sorumludur?
explanation: 📌 Hafıza Çivisi: Bu sorunun kilit cevabı -> Yetkili acenta / yükleme şefi

question: Aşağıdakilerden hangisi gizli tehlikeli maddelere örnektir?
options: Bıçak, çamaşır suyu, tiner, makas, iğne
explanation: 📌 Hafıza Çivisi: Bu sorunun kilit cevabı -> Bıçak, çamaşır suyu, tiner, makas, iğne

question: Paket üzerine ‘’THIS WAY UP’’ işareti en az kaç tane koyulmalıdır?
explanation: 📌 Hafıza Çivisi: Bu sorunun kilit cevabı -> 2

question: Uçağa Dangerous Goods yüklendiğinden kaptan nasıl haberdar olur?
explanation: 📌 Hafıza Çivisi: Bu sorunun kilit cevabı -> NOTOC (special load notification to captain)

question: Operatör, bir dangerous goods kaza ya da olayını kime rapor etmek zorundadır?
options: Kaza ya da olayın meydana geldiği ülkenin otoritesine
Resmi olarak böyle bir rapor vermeye gerek yoktur.
explanation: 📌 Hafıza Çivisi: Bu sorunun kilit cevabı -> a ve b

question: ‘’CAO’’ etiketiyle işaratlenmiş bir Dangerous Goods paketi Kargo&Yolcu uçağına nasıl yüklenip, taşınabilir?
options: IATA DGR kurallarında belirtildiği şekilde yüklenir.
’’CAO’’ işaretiyle etiketlenmiş bir paket yolcu uçağına yüklenemez.
‘’ICAO Technical Instructions for the Safe Transport of Dangerous Goods by Air’’ (DOC-9284-AN/905)’te belirtildiği şekilde yüklenir.
Şirketin belirlediği usullere göre yüklenerek taşınır.
explanation: 📌 Hafıza Çivisi: Unutma: ’’CAO’’ işaretiyle etiketlenmiş bir paket yolcu uçağına yüklenemez

question: Uçuş ekibi olarak, yolcu ve/veya ekip üyesinin taşıdığı bir maddenin, uçakta taşınmasına müsaade edilip edilmediğine nasıl karar verilir?
options: Yolcu ve/veya ekip üyesi, dangerous goods sınıfına giren hiçbir maddeyi uçakta taşıyamaz.
Ekiplerin ’’excepted quantities’’ olarak adlandırılan muaf tutulmuş miktarları taşımasına izin verilmiştir.
TABLO 2.3.A’ya göre belirlenmiş bir takım Dangerous Goods’lar gerekli koşulların yerine getirilerek taşınmasına izin verilmiştir.
Yolcu ve/veya ekip üyelerinin hangi Dangerous Goods’ları taşıyabileceğine şirket karar vererek ilan eder.
explanation: 📌 Hafıza Çivisi: Unutma: TABLO 2.3.A’ya göre belirlenmiş bir takım Dangerous Goods’lar gerekli koşulların yerine getirilerek taşınmasına izin verilmiştir

question: Uçakta taşınmakta olan ve NOTOC’ta belirtilmiş olan DG UN 2950 adlı maddeye bağlı olarak uçuşta bir emergency olması durumunda, nereye başvurularak doğru müdahale edilebilir.
options: Operatörün hazırlamış olduğu Dangerous GoodsEmergency Manual
explanation: 📌 Hafıza Çivisi: Bu sorunun kilit cevabı -> ICAO ‘’ERG’’ Emergency Response Guide (RedBook)

question: Dangerous Goods’un sahip olduğu potansiyel tehlikeyi ilk kim belirler?
explanation: 📌 Hafıza Çivisi: Bu sorunun kilit cevabı -> Gönderici

question: Hazard Label (Tehlike Etiketi) hazırlamaktan kim sorumludur?
explanation: 📌 Hafıza Çivisi: Bu sorunun kilit cevabı -> Üretici

question: If it is not possible to file a copy of the OFP with the Operator (or agent) it sould be:
options: Posted to the Operator (a certificate of proof of posting is required)
Taken in a sealed envelope to the next aerodrome where the Operator or agent has a representative
Sent to the authority within 10 days
explanation: 📌 Hafıza Çivisi: Bu sorunun kilit cevabı -> Left with the aerodrome authorities
